title: Stormwind City
body: Stormwind City is the capital of the human kingdom of Stormwind and the chief stronghold of the Alliance, raised in white stone on the northwest coast, north of Elwynn Forest. The old city was reduced to ashes when the orcish Horde sacked it in the First War and King Llane was slain. It rose again through the labor of the Stonemasons' Guild, aided by the Church of the Holy Light and by King Terenas of Lordaeron, but the nobles never paid the masons what they were owed, and those cheated builders became the Defias Brotherhood. Canals now divide the city into districts: the busy Trade District, Cathedral Square beneath the Cathedral of Light, the poor streets of Old Town, the Mage Quarter, and the Dwarven District with its tram to Ironforge. The Stockade holds the kingdom's prisoners. King Varian Wrynn sits on the throne again after long years lost, the noblewoman Katrana Prestor has been exposed as the black dragon Onyxia, and the former regent, Highlord Bolvar Fordragon, has fallen at the Wrathgate in Northrend.
sources: warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Stormwind_City (founding, First War, rebuilding by Stonemasons, Church of Light and Terenas, districts, Deeprun Tram)
quest 389 description (masons cheated by the nobles)
notes: Location phrasing aligned with the wiki (northwest coast, north of Elwynn). Otherwise verified. District names follow the pre-Cataclysm layout; 3.3.5 AreaTable has no district subzones.

title: Valley of Heroes
body: The Valley of Heroes is the southern approach to Stormwind, where a stone bridge crosses the moat to the city gates. Along the road stand five statues of the leaders of the Alliance Expedition that marched through the Dark Portal into Draenor: Archmage Khadgar, General Turalyon, Ranger Captain Alleria Windrunner, Danath Trollbane and the gryphon rider Kurdran Wildhammer. Each plaque calls its hero presumed deceased and carries a farewell from a comrade or kinsman, from Antonidas and Uther to Sylvanas Windrunner, though word from Outland says some of them still live. Field Marshal Afrasiabi and Major Mattingly keep watch here, and it is here that the Field Marshal calls the city to rally around the champions who slew Nefarian.

title: Stormwind Harbor
body: Stormwind Harbor spreads along the Great Sea below the city's northwestern quarter, a fortified port of tiered docks, cannon emplacements and steam tanks. Here, at the start of the war against the Lich King, Scourge forces struck at the city, and King Varian Wrynn and Highlord Bolvar Fordragon directed the defense from atop the harbor walls. Now the port feeds that war. The steam-powered Kraken carries soldiers to Valiance Keep in the Borean Tundra, while The Bravery sails for Auberdine in Darkshore from a dock watched by night elf sentinels. Not every ship is so ready: the captain of the Assurance complains that his vessel has somehow been overrun with bugs.

title: King Varian Wrynn
body: Varian Wrynn was a boy when the orcs sacked Stormwind and King Llane, his father, was assassinated. Raised in exile in Lordaeron, he returned to rule the rebuilt city, married Tiffin and fathered a son, only to lose his queen in the riot that grew out of the nobles' quarrel with the Stonemasons. Sailing in secret to meet Jaina Proudmoore at Theramore, he was abducted by the Defias. Stripped of his memory, he fought as a gladiator called Lo'Gosh before reclaiming his name and his throne, and Lady Prestor was unmasked as Onyxia on his return. A fierce and grieving king, he blames the Horde for the Wrathgate and puts little faith in peace.
sources: warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Varian_Wrynn (youth, exile, Tiffin, abduction, Lo'Gosh, Onyxia unmasked, Wrathgate)

title: Prince Anduin Wrynn
body: Prince Anduin Wrynn, son of King Varian and the late Queen Tiffin, was named for the hero Anduin Lothar and for his grandfather Llane. When his father vanished, Lady Katrana Prestor urged the council to crown the boy so that order might be kept, and he reigned in name while Highlord Bolvar Fordragon governed as regent. The deception ended when Prestor was revealed as Onyxia, who carried the boy off to her lair before he was rescued. Now the prince stands beside the throne once more, a quiet and thoughtful boy where his father is fierce.
sources: warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Anduin_Wrynn (birth, naming, crowning under Bolvar's regency at Prestor's urging, kidnapping by Onyxia, personality, interest in the Light)

title: Highlord Bolvar Fordragon
body: Highlord Bolvar Fordragon, a paladin of the Silver Hand, ruled Stormwind as regent for young Anduin while King Varian was lost. Lady Prestor stood at his side, and only after she was unmasked did it become known that a medallion she had placed around his neck, the Dragon's Eye, had held his mind and body captive. When Varian returned, Bolvar led the Alliance north against the Lich King. At Angrathar the Wrathgate the Forsaken traitor Putress loosed a plague upon Alliance and Horde alike, and the red dragonflight burned the field clean. Bolvar's body was never found. His shield was carried home to the king, who blamed himself for the loss.
sources: warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Bolvar_Fordragon (Silver Hand, regent, Drakefire Amulet, Valiance Expedition, Wrathgate)

title: Master Mathias Shaw
body: Master Mathias Shaw leads SI:7, the kingdom's intelligence service, from the barracks in Old Town. Few shady or underhanded dealings in the city escape his notice, and he likes to call himself the master of all assassins. It was Shaw who recognized the quiet visitor to Bazil Thredd's cell as the assassin Marzon and traced him to Lord Gregor Lescovar, and his agents keep watch on the Defias in Westfall. When five of his best field agents went to the Eastern Plaguelands after the lost ranger lord Nathanos Marris, only one came back, to die in his sleep days later. With Ravenholdt refusing aid, Shaw had to seek outside help to learn their fate.
sources: quest 394 reward text (master of all assassins)
notes: verified (Westfall watch supported by quest 2360, SI:7 reconnaissance and Agent Kearnen).

title: Archbishop Benedictus
body: Archbishop Benedictus leads the Church of the Holy Light from the Cathedral of Light in Cathedral Square. In his youth he studied under Archbishop Alonsus Faol, the benevolent patron who raised great sums to rebuild Stormwind after the Second War, and he helped the Church raise the Cathedral of Light that stands as a monument to his teacher. Benedictus succeeded his teacher at the head of the Church. From his cathedral he keeps watch on the Scourge even in distant lands: he has sent champions into Razorfen Downs to break the pact between the quilboar there and the lich Amnennar the Coldbringer. Tainted Eyes of Paleth, crafted long ago by human priests, are brought to him to be cleansed.
sources: warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Archbishop_Benedictus (pupil of Faol, built the Cathedral, succeeded him)
notes: Wiki says he was Faol's student in his youth and helped the Church build the Cathedral; 'many years' and 'the two built it together' corrected. Twilight's Hammer allegiance (Cataclysm) left out. Faction 1: template 12.

title: Baros Alexston
body: Baros Alexston, City Architect of Stormwind, keeps his office at City Hall in Cathedral Square. He grew up working his family's farm in Westfall, a homestead since burned and seized by thieves. As a young man he was a member of the Stonemasons' Guild with Edwin VanCleef, rebuilding the city after the war. When the nobles refused to pay, VanCleef led a riot and left the city swearing revenge, while Baros accepted the post of city architect and stayed in Stormwind's service. He still calls his old colleague an idealist and a romantic consumed by revenge, yet admits he cannot entirely blame him. Mathias Shaw of SI:7 owes him a favor.
sources: quest 393 description (Shaw owes me a favor)
warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Baros_Alexston (accepted the city architect position rather than join VanCleef)
notes: Staying in Stormwind's service confirmed by the wiki (he took the architect post instead of joining VanCleef). Faction 1: template 12.

title: Elling Trias
body: Elling Trias runs Trias' Cheese in the Trade District with his wife Elaine and his son Ben, and will happily offer a taste of Trias cheddar or a block of Darnassian bleu. Those who know better come to him for something else. Behind the counter lies a quiet web of friends and contacts that reaches from Stormwind Keep to Darkshire, Menethil Harbor and Theramore, and when the kingdom's own agents cannot act, Trias can. He has little love for Mathias Shaw, who turns to him only when he must, and he prefers his justice swift and off the record. Those who trouble his friends, he says, rarely stay healthy for long.
sources: quest 1242 request text (cheddar and Darnassian bleu)
notes: Closing line rephrased to avoid near-verbatim quest text. Otherwise verified. Faction 1: template 12.

title: Zardeth of the Black Claw
body: In the cellar of the Slaughtered Lamb tavern in the Mage Quarter, Zardeth of the Black Claw speaks for the warlocks of Stormwind, served by a demon named Zggi. Their gatherings drew the ire of Lord Baurles K. Wishock of the House of Nobles, who lobbied for a full investigation, though Zardeth notes that the lord spends his nights upstairs running up a bill he never pays. Zardeth answered him with a special Black Claw stout, brewed from a rare flower of Darkshire and a root from the Wetlands, and the warlocks have practiced their ways undisturbed ever since. Of late even the head of the dragon Onyxia has found its way down to his cellar, much to his puzzlement.
sources: quest 24428 description and reward text (basement of the Slaughtered Lamb)
creature_template 1733 Zggi, Zardeth's Minion, creature type demon
notes: 'Presides over' softened: the warlock trainer Gakin also works there and nothing names Zardeth their leader. Wiki says the stout proved fatal; quests only say Wishock enjoyed it, so the entry stays vague. Faction 1: template 12.

title: The Missing King
body: It began with a whisper. Thomas, an altar boy, quietly sought out capable strangers for Bishop DeLavey, who confided that a diplomat bound for Theramore to meet Jaina Proudmoore had never arrived, and that the Defias were somehow involved. DeLavey's old friend Jorgen, fishing in the Valley of Heroes, passed the matter to the cheesemonger Elling Trias. A Defias docket found at Addle's Stead in Duskwood named a brawler called Fist, Dashel Stonefist of Old Town, who after a beating gave up an inside man from Menethil known as Slim. Cornered in Menethil's tavern, Tapoke Jahn confessed: the Defias had taken no mere diplomat but the king himself, with help from a partner greater than they, and their man Hendel had been placed aboard the royal ship. Hendel proved to be a soldier of the Theramore garrison. He was brought down in Dustwallow Marsh, and Lady Proudmoore quietly thanked those who had uncovered the plot.
sources: creature 4959 Jorgen spawned in the Valley of Heroes
notes: verified. Chain entry is 1274 (prerequisite of 1241). Faction 1: all quests AllowableRaces 1101 except the note delivery 1242.

title: VanCleef's Last Plot
body: Even in death Edwin VanCleef had one more scheme. An unsent letter on his body, addressed to the City Architect Baros Alexston, led Baros to recall their days as Stonemasons and to point toward Bazil Thredd, VanCleef's lieutenant, held in the Stockade. Thredd was slain amid a riot in the prison, but Warden Thelwater revealed that a quiet stranger calling himself Maelik had lately visited him often. Mathias Shaw knew the description: the assassin Marzon, in the pay of Lord Gregor Lescovar. With VanCleef and Thredd dead, no court would touch so well connected a noble, so Shaw reluctantly sent word to Elling Trias. Trias's friend Tyrion, a gnome who had been watching Lescovar for weeks, used a disguised Spybot to draw the lord into the castle garden to meet Marzon. Once their talk of the Defias was overheard, both were cut down, and Baros's report on the Brotherhood went to the king.
sources: DB spawns: Lord Gregor Lescovar 1754 and Tyrion 7766 at Stormwind Keep
notes: verified. 373 starts from an item on VanCleef in the Deadmines; 389 is the first quest given in the city. The Stockade part is told only in passing. Faction 1: all quests AllowableRaces 1101.

title: The Blightcaller
body: Nathanos Marris was the first and last of the human ranger lords, the only human ever allowed to train under the high elves, and a disciple of Sylvanas Windrunner. He was believed to have died defending Lordaeron, though his body was never found. When strange Forsaken activity was reported in the Eastern Plaguelands, SI:7 sent five of its best agents to investigate. One came back, able to utter only two words, Nathanos and Blightcaller, before dying in his sleep. At King Varian's word Mathias Shaw sent volunteers to Flint Shadowmore at Chillwind Camp, and the insignias of the lost agents were recovered in the east. The truth shook the king: the Blightcaller was Nathanos himself, now champion of the Banshee Queen. Varian ordered an army raised to destroy him, and mourned that his people seem cursed to lose their greatest heroes.

title: Dragons at Court
body: For years the House of Wrynn was steered from the shadows. Lady Katrana Prestor, a high noble and royal councilor, urged the crowning of the boy Anduin and stood at the regent's side, while a medallion she had placed upon Bolvar Fordragon held him captive. She was Onyxia, brood of Deathwing and twin of Nefarian, the tyrant of Blackrock Spire. Her masquerade ended in Stormwind Keep, at the cost of Marshal Reginald Windsor's life, and she fled with the young prince to her lair in the Wyrmbog of Dustwallow Marsh. Her brother fared no better at the hands of the Alliance. When Nefarian's head was carried back to Stormwind, King Varian hailed a victory the like of which the Alliance had not known in years, and Field Marshal Afrasiabi called the city to rally around its champions in the Valley of Heroes.
sources: quest 6403 description and reward text (Prestor is Onyxia, twin of Nefarian, the Highlord a puppet, Windsor's sacrifice)
warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Katrana_Prestor (councilor, Anduin crowned at her urging, Windsor killed, Anduin taken to her lair)
notes: verified. The Windsor chain (6402, 6403) has no quest givers in this DB, so the unmasking is told as history and the story unlocks on the Nefarian head quest. Faction 1: 7781 AllowableRaces 1101.

title: The Wrathgate and the King's Wrath
body: When Bolvar Fordragon fell at the Wrathgate, the dragon queen Alexstrasza sent his shield home to King Varian with a message: all is not lost, and from the ashes of the fallen a force will rise to purge the evil from the world. Varian took it as a call to purge the Horde. At Jaina Proudmoore's urging he first allowed a diplomatic mission, and Jaina went to Orgrimmar to hear Thrall out. The Warchief swore the Horde had no part in Putress's cowardly attack, that it too had lost heroes, and that it would defend itself if provoked. Learning that the Horde had lost the Undercity, Varian seized the moment. Broll Bearmantle and Valeera Sanguinar already waited outside the ruins, Jaina opened a portal from Stormwind Keep, and the king led the Alliance in to bring Putress to justice. He came home convinced that peace with the Horde had won his people nothing.
sources: npc_text 14131 (Jaina: avoid another war at all costs)
notes: verified. 13347 is accepted in Dragonblight, so its turn-in to Varian is used instead; 13369 is the first quest given in Stormwind. Faction 1: all quests AllowableRaces 1101.

title: Where Kings Walk
body: When the Knights of the Ebon Blade broke from the Lich King, Highlord Darion Mograine sent those death knights who had once been heroes of the Alliance to Stormwind as envoys, bearing a letter from Tirion Fordring. Their welcome was bitter. Guards, some of whom had lost their families to the Scourge, pelted them with rotten fruit, spat at them and cried murderer and monster as they made their way to the keep. King Varian declared that only the word of Tirion, one of the greatest paladins ever to live, kept the envoy from becoming a stain upon his floor. Yet he honored his old friend's letter. Blood and honor, he answered, and he pledged that Stormwind would fight alongside the Ebon Blade against the Scourge and the Lich King.
